question:
Identify the error in the sentence.

We must respect the elder people in our community.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the adjective "**elder**" before the noun "**people**."
 
• The word "**elder**" is typically used to compare ages within a family (e.g., an elder brother) or acts as a noun on its own (e.g., respect your elders).
 
• When referring to older adults in a general sense, the correct adjective to use is "**elderly**" or "**older**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 3** of the question.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"We must respect the **elderly** people in our community."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "respect" **– This word is grammatically correct as the base verb following the modal auxiliary "must."
 
• **Option 2: "people"** – This word is grammatically correct and appropriately serves as the object being modified in the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "community"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and properly completes the prepositional phrase.
